# HanToggle

> HanToggle is a free, open-source macOS menu-bar utility that toggles selected Chinese text between Simplified and Traditional with a configurable global hotkey.

HanToggle performs conversion locally on the Mac. It does not use analytics, telemetry, update checks, network conversion, or text logging. It restores the previous clipboard contents after conversion whenever possible.

## Official pages

- [Simplified Chinese](https://minorole.github.io/HanToggle/): Product overview, setup, privacy, download, and FAQ in Simplified Chinese.
- [Traditional Chinese](https://minorole.github.io/HanToggle/zh-hant/): Product overview, setup, privacy, download, and FAQ in Traditional Chinese.
- [English](https://minorole.github.io/HanToggle/en/): Product overview, setup, privacy, download, and FAQ in English.
- [Source code](https://github.com/minorole/HanToggle): Swift source, tests, documentation, and MIT License.
- [Releases](https://github.com/minorole/HanToggle/releases): Current notarized DMG downloads and release notes.

## Product facts

- Platform: macOS 13 or later.
- Hardware: Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
- Workflow: select Chinese text, press the configured hotkey, and press it again to reverse the conversion.
- Distribution: free DMG downloads from GitHub Releases.
- License: MIT.

## Support and privacy

- Support: hi@minor-role.com
- Do not include private selected text, clipboard contents, credentials, tokens, keys, or personal data in support messages.
